tytul: Teewurst: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for German teewurst, a raw smoked spreadable sausage that is eaten without cooking.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UGA, uncooked smoked sausages are smoked for flavor development and must be fully cooked before eating.
Without an effective starter culture, fermentation temperatures of 80–100 °F can let dangerous bacteria grow in the meat.
Too much nitrate or nitrite can be toxic to people.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for teewurst from a checked source.
